title: Melatonin prevents glyphosate-induced hepatic lipid accumulation in roosters via activating Nrf2 pathway.
authors: Zhang, Shu-Hui; Zhang, Hai-Jing; Jia, Yan-Zhan; Wang, Zhen-Yong; You, Zhao-Hong; Lian, Cai-Yu; Wang, Lin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褪黑素通过Nrf2通路缓解草甘膦致鸡肝脂质积累，仅用分子对接辅助说明MET与Nrf2结合，核心为毒理学与氧化应激机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Glyphosate (GLY) is a widely used herbicide with well-defined hepatotoxic effects, in which oxidative stress has been shown to be involved in the pathogenesis of hepatotoxicity. Melatonin (MET), an effective free radical scavenger, has been revealed to alleviate drug-induced liver damage by inhibiting oxidative stress. METHODS: In this study, a rooster model with primary chicken embryo hepatocytes was applied to elucidate the therapeutic effects of MET against GLY-induced hepatic damage and the potential mechanism. Histopathological examinations, biochemical tests and immunoblotting analysis were used to monitor the protective effects of MET on GLY-induced hepatic lipid accumulation. Molecular docking analysis was used to reveal the key reason of MET-improved hepatic lipid deposition. RESULTS: Data firstly showed that MET administration markedly improved GLY-induced hepatic injury, as evidenced by normalized liver enzymes and alleviated pathological changes of liver tissues. Moreover, MET supplementation alleviated GLY-induced hepatic lipid accumulation, which was correlated with improved serum and hepatic lipid profiles and normalized expression of lipolysis- and lipogenesis-related proteins. Notably, MET significantly inhibited vital enzymes involved in stimulating oxidative stress. Moreover, MET enhanced GLY-inhibited Nrf2 nuclear transcription and increased the expressions of its downstream target genes HO1 and NQO1. Further studies revealed that MET may interact with Nrf2 to enhance nuclear translocation of Nrf2. CONCLUSION: Collectively, our results provide the first direct evidence that MET is a novel regulator of Nrf2, highlighting that Nrf2 may be a potential therapeutic target for GLY-induced lipotoxic liver injury.
abstract_zh: 背景：草甘膦（GLY）是一种广泛使用的除草剂，具有明确的肝毒性作用，其中氧化应激已被证明参与肝毒性的发病机制。褪黑素（MET）作为一种有效的自由基清除剂，已被揭示通过抑制氧化应激来减轻药物诱导的肝损伤。方法：在本研究中，采用原代鸡胚肝细胞公鸡模型，以阐明MET对GLY诱导的肝损伤的治疗效果及其潜在机制。通过组织病理学检查、生化检测和免疫印迹分析来监测MET对GLY诱导的肝脏脂质积累的保护作用。分子对接分析用于揭示MET改善肝脏脂质沉积的关键原因。结果：数据首先显示，MET给药显著改善了GLY诱导的肝损伤，表现为肝酶恢复正常和肝组织病理变化减轻。此外，MET补充减轻了GLY诱导的肝脏脂质积累，这与血清和肝脏脂质谱的改善以及脂解和脂生成相关蛋白表达的正常化相关。值得注意的是，MET显著抑制了参与刺激氧化应激的关键酶。此外，MET增强了GLY抑制的Nrf2核转录，并增加了其下游靶基因HO1和NQO1的表达。进一步研究表明，MET可能与Nrf2相互作用以增强Nrf2的核转位。结论：总体而言，我们的结果提供了首个直接证据，表明MET是Nrf2的新型调节因子，强调Nrf2可能是GLY诱导的脂毒性肝损伤的潜在治疗靶点。
